# ShowOff4U - Technical Publishing & Developer Community Platform

> ShowOff4U is an automated, high-performance publishing workspace for developers, creators, teachers, and technical learning enthusiasts.

## Core Features
- Technical Markdown publishing with code syntax highlighting.
- Automated AI-assisted article generation and image design prompts.
- Developer project showcase and portfolio hub.
- Bookmark, like, and rich community commenting systems.

## Primary Links
- Website: https://www.showoff4u.in
- Blogs Directory: https://www.showoff4u.in/blogs
